en.text:
Grenade Ability usage or scoring a Grenade Kill grants 1 stack of Explosive Pact for 7.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

<solar/>Healing Grenade orb pickups (by anyone) and Grenade Kills grant 1 stack each.

Running over a <yellow Speaker's Sight /> Healing Turret does not grant any stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks of Explosive Pact:
• ? Stability
• 8|16|20|24|44 Reload Speed
• 0.98x|0.98x|0.975x|0.96x|0.945x Reload Duration Multiplier
